title: Reading progress summary
objective: Add deterministic reading progress and a compact shelf summary without mutating caller-owned data.
requirements: Reading exposes readonly id, title, totalPages, and pagesRead fields.
readingProgress returns 0 when totalPages is zero or negative; otherwise it clamps pagesRead into [0, totalPages] and returns Math.floor(clamped / totalPages * 100).

summarizeReadings returns exactly "<count> books · <complete> complete · <remaining> pages remaining"; complete means readingProgress is 100, and remaining sums max(0, totalPages - max(0, pagesRead)).
